definitions.explanation: An informal word for mother, typically used by young children or in casual family contexts.

examples.japanese: ママ、⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦{空|す}いた→すく：00756_suku⟧。
ママ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いてみて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ママ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My mom is good at cooking.

notes:
LOANWORD from English "mama."

RELATED WORDS (other words for mother):
- ママ (mama - casual, children's speech)
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ (mother - polite, common)
- ⟦お{袋|ふくろ}→おふくろ：10246_ofukuro⟧ (mother - casual, typically male speakers)
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ (mother - humble, formal)
- ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧ (mother - neutral, objective)

USAGE: ママ is commonly used by young children. Some adults continue using it in casual family settings, while others switch to ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ as they grow older.

PAIR: ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧ (papa, dad)
